newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank scraps Friday's notes auction. [CORRECTED 09:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank scraps Friday's notes auction. [CORRECTED 09:50 GMT]

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said on Thursday that it had cancelled its auction of a total of 4.0 billion (corrects from 5.0 billion) baht in 29-day and 91-day notes set for Friday.
"Due to changing market liquidity, the Bank of Thailand called off the auction...," the central bank said in a statement.
Liquidity has been tight in the system forcing overnight interbank rates to jump this week.
